operation_details.item: The user held the board preview meeting for the Q3 earnings last week.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just got out of that long ops review. Need a coffee. How's your week going?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh, same old. But hey, I saw the Q3 earnings draft is done — nice work. Are we on track for the investor call?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, draft's complete, and the call is locked for next Tuesday. The CFO is still fiddling with the cash-flow appendix, but nothing crazy.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. And how did the board preview go last week? I heard you held that meeting.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I held the board preview meeting for Q3 earnings last week. It went pretty well — they had a few questions but overall seemed satisfied.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good to hear. So just the appendix and then we're set for Tuesday, right?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I'm confident we'll be ready. By the way, are you joining the pre-call sync tomorrow?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I'll be there. I'll bring the updated metrics deck. Anything else you need from me?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Just those metrics, and maybe double-check the Q&A prep doc. But no rush.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Will do. Let's grab that coffee later, then.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I held the Q3 board preview meeting last week; keep the draft status and the upcoming investor call.
